title: PRO People: Sofia POLCANOVA
body_html:
“PRO PEOPLE” — a show produced by WeSport, dedicated to people who live and breathe SPORT!

Discover the fascinating story behind great performances and learn the secrets of the famous Sofia POLCANOVA, who has taken her passion for sport to another level. The show’s heroine is a multiple European table tennis champion ranked in the world TOP-15.
